ownerProfile.title: Owner Profile
ownerProfile.intro: Your verified owner identity, FIT information and live network genealogy — all in one secure space.
ownerProfile.signatureNote: A registered Network Owner wallet must sign a free message to verify ownership. No transaction or gas fee is required.
ownerProfile.recoveryNote: Sign a free message with any verified wallet already linked to this Owner Profile.
ownerProfile.profitTitle: Estimated FIT price growth on current balance
ownerProfile.profitNote: Profit/loss is estimated using the wallet's current FIT balance multiplied by the price difference. Historical wallet balances are not available from this calculation.
ownerProfile.networkNote: Counts are read live from Owner_Left_Right_All on the BNB Smart Chain network contract.
ownerProfile.treeHint: Open any address to load its direct left and right addresses on demand.
ownerProfile.liveTreeNote: Genealogy is fetched directly from the smart contract. It is not saved to the website database; expanded branches are held only in this page's memory.
ownerProfile.walletUnavailable: Wallet provider is unavailable. Open the site inside your wallet or use Connect wallet.
ownerProfile.signing: Please approve the free signature request in your wallet.
ownerProfile.usernameRules: Username must be 3–24 English letters, numbers or underscores.
ownerProfile.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ownerProfile.removeConfirm: Remove this secondary wallet from your Owner Profile?
ownerProfile.notOwner: This address is not currently registered as a Network Owner.
ownerProfile.readFailed: Could not read the BNB Smart Chain contracts. Please try again.
ownerProfile.emptyAddress: Empty branch — zero address returned by contract
ownerProfile.treeLimit: Display limit reached. Collapse some branches to continue.
ownerProfile.treeWaiting: Live contract data will appear here.
ownerProfile.walletLoaded: Wallet data loaded live from the contracts.
ownerProfile.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
ownerProfile.passwordRecovered: Password updated. Previous sessions were signed out.
